newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann sees slightly better 1996 result.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann sees slightly better 1996 result.

text.p: German engineering group Mannesmann AG said on Tuesday it expected earnings from its ordinary business activities in the current year to be "slightly ahead" of that in the year 1995.
Mannesmann said that in the first nine months of the year its turnover had risen by six percent.
Mannesmann saids in a statement the increase in nine month turnover was due to improvements in the sectors of automotive technology and particularly in telecommunications.
Incoming orders to September were around the same as the year before. On an adjusted basis, they had risen one percent and were 13 percent higher than turnover.
Group investments rose 17 percent to 1.7 billion marks.
